tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures support a basin-siphon baseline, but six rows—including only one open-branch probe—leave the two-layer branch term underidentified. An extra fine trajectory batch is the most direct way to constrain it before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the hydraulic basin siphon model from the six rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The non-monotonic residuals across u_now and the single open-branch observation do not identify the branch term; a fitted smooth baseline could extrapolate poorly.
This auxiliary measurement is irrelevant to resolving the branch mechanism and costs 3.5.
The open-branch point alone is insufficient to distinguish candidate branch behaviors at the required forecast horizon.
